name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: For nonempty finite binary classes, the projection closures of positive recursive teaching, positive no-clashing teaching, and maximum positive degree coincide. The reverse bound follows by projecting an inclusion-minimal positive teaching set and then removing inclusion-maximal concepts.
proof_source: Proposition \ref{prop:positive-projection-collapse} in the survey; independent small-class regression: sync/verify_positive_projection_collapse.py.
